mapper.select: select r.* from arte_rbac_role r left join arte_rbac_relation rr on r.role_code = rr.target where rr.binding_type = 'user_to_role' and rr.source = #{userName}
select r.* from arte_rbac_menu r left join arte_rbac_relation rr on r.menu_code = rr.target where rr.binding_type = 'user_to_menu' and rr.source = #{userName}
